items.title: Klavye gezinimi ve Meta+1..9
items.evidence_note: AUDITED 2026-10-30: keyboard navigation implemented (modules/dock/DockKeyboardNav.qml; tests/test_dock_keyboard.py 18 tests). RUSH 2026-10-30 (task 2): Meta+1..9 global shortcuts IMPLEMENTED in working tree (not yet committed). Resident KWin script services/kwin/scripts/kwin-meta-shortcuts.js registers Meta+1..9 via registerShortcut() and activates/minimizes/cycles the Nth pinned dock app's windows natively (resourceClass/resourceName/desktopFileName matched against alias keys embedded at load time by services/kwin/MetaShortcuts.js + kwin-meta-shortcuts.sh; same alias rules as dock running indicators). Lifecycle in WindowService.qml: debounced reload on pinned-list change, orphan cleanup on load (stable plugin name quickshell-dock-meta-shortcuts), unload on disable/shell shutdown, bounded retry. Config knob dockMetaShortcuts (bool, default false, opt-in because it registers system-wide kglobalaccel shortcuts) + Settings toggle. Verified in isolated kwin_wayland --virtual rig (tests/test_dock_meta_shortcuts.py: 23 tests incl. real registerShortcut + kglobalaccel invokeShortcut activation/cycle/unload; full suite green except known env failure test_12_live_kwin_running_apps_enumeration). Limitations: no app launch when pinned app has no windows (KWin scripts cannot spawn processes); shortcuts lost on KWin restart until next reload trigger.
